entities.summary: Contract of the Century and Oil Boom, a transformative movement in Azerbaijan (1994–2020). Emerged from Contract of the Century signed with international oil consortium and First Karabakh War and Displacement. Catalyzed Baku-Tbilisi-Ceyhan pipeline inaugurated and 44-day war ends with Azerbaijani victory and trilateral ceasefire.
